title: D&D 5.5e Character Authoring Schema
description: A self-contained JSON Schema for authoring a complete Dungeons & Dragons 5.5e character sheet in the 'Heroes Guild' West Marches format. Feed this schema to an LLM together with a short prompt (e.g. 'create a level-3 elven wizard') and ask it for a single JSON object matching this schema. Every enum is exhaustive: only the listed values are valid. Derived values (abilityScores, profBonus, hp_max, spell save DC) are NOT authored — the application computes them from the inputs below.

name.description: The character's full name, e.g. 'Elara Vance'. REQUIRED.

title.description: An optional epithet or title, e.g. 'Seeker of the Arcane'. Use an empty string if none.

jobInParty.description: The character's informal party role, e.g. 'Tank', 'Healer', 'Face'. Use an empty string if none.

class.description: The character's class. REQUIRED. Must be exactly one of the enum values.

renownTier.description: West Marches Renown Tier (1=levels 1-4, 2=levels 5-8, 3=levels 9-12). Defaults to 1.

species.description: The character's species. REQUIRED. Must be exactly one of the enum values.

subChoice.description: Optional sub-choice id for species with lineages/ancestries/legacies, e.g. 'high-elf', 'wood-elf', 'drow' (Elf); 'cloud-giant', 'fire-giant' (Goliath); 'infernal', 'abyssal' (Tiefling). Use null when the species has no sub-choices.

background.description: The character's background. REQUIRED. Must be exactly one of the enum values.

pointBuyBaseScores.description: The six base ability scores purchased with the standard 27-point point-buy budget. Each is between 8 and 15. REQUIRED. A legal point-buy array costs exactly 27 points (costs: 8=0, 9=1, 10=2, 11=3, 12=4, 13=5, 14=7, 15=9).

backgroundBonusSelections.description: Which ability scores receive the background's +2 and +1 bonuses. The two values MUST be different ability keys. REQUIRED.

plusOne.description: Ability key receiving +1 (must differ from plusTwo).

proficiencies.description: Skill and saving-throw proficiencies. Optional: the app also derives fixed class/background proficiencies, but list the character's chosen ones here.

skills.description: Proficient skills, normalized to lowercase with no spaces.

savingThrows.description: Proficient saving throws as ability keys.

attacks.description: Weapon and spell attacks. Optional; the app auto-seeds weapon attacks from equipped gear when this is empty.

atkStat.description: Ability used for the attack roll.

dmgDie.description: Damage die in XdY form, e.g. '1d6', '2d6'.

notes.description: Optional notes, e.g. 'Ranged Spell Attack, 120 ft.'

features.description: All character features and traits, including class features, species traits, background features, and feats. Optional; the app also auto-applies class/species/background features.

desc.description: Full description of the feature. Plain text or Markdown.

key.description: Whether this appears in the prominent 'key features' list.

resource.description: Limited-use tracking. Use null for always-on features.

resourceType.description: 'static' = fixed count, 'scaling' = derived from a stat.

value.description: Fixed number of uses (only for resourceType 'static').

scalingStat.description: Stat used when resourceType is 'scaling' (pb = proficiency bonus).

casterType.description: Spellcasting progression granted by this feature, or null.

personality.description: Roleplay personality block. Recommended for well-rounded characters.

traits.description: One or two personality traits, e.g. 'I am never without my spellbook.'

ideal.description: A core belief, e.g. 'Knowledge. The path to power is through knowledge.'

bond.description: A connection to people, places or things.

equipment.description: Free-text summary of carried equipment, e.g. 'A quarterstaff, a spellbook and a scholar's pack.'

spellcasting.description: Set only for characters whose class/features grant spellcasting; otherwise null.

spells.description: Known and/or prepared spells. Optional for non-casters.

desc.description: Short description of the spell's effect.

equippedGear.description: Structured equipped items. Optional; equipment text is usually enough for authoring.

id.description: Stable unique id for the item instance.

consumables.description: Consumable items tracked with usage dice. Optional.
